topics.name: streaks and gamification
topics.description: Streaks, badges, leagues, XP, gems, quests and reminders, and whether they motivate or pressure learners.

topics.name: lesson format and content design
topics.description: Lesson length, structure, pacing, variety, repetition, exercise types and curriculum flow.

topics.name: pronunciation and speech scoring
topics.description: Accuracy, usefulness and reliability of speaking exercises, microphone scoring, accent feedback and speech recognition.

topics.name: offline mode and technical issues
topics.description: Offline downloads, device syncing, installation, login and two-step verification problems, and app bugs or support.

topics.name: conversation bot practice
topics.description: Quality, realism, memory, correction behaviour and scenarios of the AI chat or practice bot for conversation.

topics.name: live tutor sessions
topics.description: Experiences with human tutors, including quality, booking, availability, cancellation rules and session reliability.

topics.name: grammar explanations
topics.description: How well the course explains grammar rules, including notes, tables, references and clarity of explanations versus textbooks.

topics.name: language and course coverage
topics.description: Range of available languages, depth of individual courses, course levels and dialect or base-language options.

topics.name: progress tracking and placement
topics.description: Placement tests, level estimates, progress dashboards, skill charts, summaries and accuracy of fluency measures.

method.providerLabel: Two-phase topics (Anthropic claude-sonnet-5-5 (topic-discovery-v2) → consolidation (topic-consolidation-v3) + TypeSafe jev-latest (jev-topic-a1), batches of ≤ 25)
